summary.text: James Duffie, a Republican U.S. Navy veteran and retired business executive, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Georgia's 4th Congressional District to Hank Johnson Jr.
He later worked as a company president and CEO.

paragraphs.text: Duffie graduated from Avondale High School and attended the Georgia Institute of Technology.
He served in the U.S. Navy from 1961 to 1968 and later worked as a company president and CEO; he says he came from humble beginnings and achieved his American dream through hard work.
He advanced from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary for the 4th District unopposed, with 17,390 votes.
During the campaign, he advocated replacing the federal income tax with the FairTax and keeping borders secure.
He received 17.4% of the vote to Hank Johnson Jr.'s 82.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
